verses.en: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.sm: Atua. Ierusalema Sa nonofo alii o le nuu i Ierusalema; a o e na totoe o le nuu ua latou fai le vili, e au mai le tasi mai taitoasefulu e riofo i Ierusalema le aai paia, a e tuua le taitoaiva i nisi aai.

verses.en: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ona faamanuia lea e le nuu o tagata uma, e na ofo fua e nonofo i Ierusalema.

verses.en: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
verses.sm: O matai nei o le nuu o e sa nonofo i Ierusalema; a ua nonofo i aai o Tuta taitoatasi i lona tofi i o latou aai, o Isaraelu, o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ma le au netini, ma le fanauga a auauna a Solomona.

verses.en: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.sm: Sa nonofo foi i Ierusalema nisi o le fanauga a Iuta, ma nisi o le fanauga a Peniamina. O le fanauga a Iuta; o Ataia le atalii o Usi, o le atalii ia o Sakaria, o le atalii ia o Amaria, o le atalii ia o Sefatia, o le atalii ia o Maalaelu, ai le fanauga a Faresa;

verses.en: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.sm: o Maaseia foi le atalii 0 Paruka, o le atalii ia o Kolokuse, o le atalii ia o Hasaia, o le atalii ia o Ataia, O le atalii ia o Ioiaripa, o le atalii ia o Sakaria, o le atalii ia o Seloni.

verses.en: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.sm: O le fanauga uma a Faresa o e sa nonofo i Ierusalema e fa selau ma le toaonogafulu ma le toavalu, o tagata malolosi.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.sm: O le fanauga foi nei a Peniamina; o Salu le atalii o Mesulama, o le atalii ia o Ioeta, o le atalii ia o Petaia, o le atalii ia o Kulaia, o le atalii ia o Maaseia, o le atalii ia o Itielu, O le atalii ia o Isaia.

verses.en: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.sm: E aupito ane foi ic te ia o Kapai, ma Salai, e toaiva selau ma le toaluafulu ma le toavalu.

verses.en: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.sm: Na pule foi ia te i latou o Ioelu le atalii o Sekeri; o lona lua foi o pule i le aai, o Iuta lea le atalii o Senua.

verses.en: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.sm: O faitaulaga; o letaia le atalii o Ioiaripa ma lakinu,

verses.en: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.sm: O Seraia le atalii o Hilikia, o le atalii 1a o Mesulama, o le atalii ia o Satoka, o le atalii ia o Meraiota, o le atalii ia O Akitopo, na pule ia i le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
verses.sm: O latou uso foi o e na fai le galuega i le fale, e valu selau ma le toaluafulu ma le toalua i latou; o Ataia foi le atalii o leroama, o le atalii ia o Pelalia, O le atalii ia o Amesi, o le atalii ia o Sakaria, o le atalii ia o Pasura, O le atalii ia O Malekia,

verses.en: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.sm: ma ona uso o matai sili, e lua selau ma le toafagafulu ma le toalua; ma Amasesai le atalii o Asareelu, o le atalii ia o Aasai, o le atalii ia o Meselemita, o le atalii ia o Imeru,

verses.en: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.sm: o latou uso foi, o toa malolosi, e selau e toaluafulu ma le toavalu; na pule foi ia te i latou o Sapetielu le atalii o Hagetolima.

verses.en: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.sm: O sa Levi foi; o Semaia le atalii o Hasupo, o le atalii ja o Aserikama, o le atalii ia o Hasapea, o le atalii ia o Puni;

verses.en: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.sm: O Sapetai foi ma Iosapata, o matai o sa Levi, na la pule i le galuega i fafo o le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.sm: O Matenaia foi le atalii o Mika, o le atalii ia o Sapata, o le atalii ia o Asafo, o le matai lea e amata ai le faafetai ma le tatalo; o Pakepuka foi, o lona lua lea i ona uso, ma Apeta, le atalii o Samua, o le atalii ia o Kalali, o le atalii ia o Iutana.

verses.en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.sm: O sa Levi uma i le aai paia, e lua selau ma le toavalugafulu ma le toafa i latou.

verses.en: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.sm: O leo714 leo faitotoa foi, o Akupa ma Talemoni, ma o latou uso o e na leoleo i faitotoa, e tasi le selau ma le toafitugafulu ma le toalua i latou.

verses.en: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.sm: O ena totoe o Isaraelu, o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, sa i aai uma o Iuta i latou taitoatasi i lona tofi.

verses.en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.sm: A ole au netini, ua latou nonofo i Ofele; na pule foi i le au netini o Seka ma Gisepa.

verses.en: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.sm: O le na pule foi i sa Levi i Ierusalema, o Usi le atalii o Pani, o le atalii ia o Hasapea, o le atalii ia o Matania, o le atalii ia o Mika. O le fanauga a Asafo, o e pepese na pule i latou i le galuega i le fale o le Atua.

verses.en: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.sm: Aua o le poloaiga a le tupu ia te i latou, ia fai le vaega o mea e ‘ai a e pepese i lea aso ma lea aso.

verses.en: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.sm: O Petakia foi le atalii o Mesesapelu, ai le fanauga a Sera le atalii o Iuta, sa i tafatafa o le tupu ia i mea uma a le nuu.

verses.en: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath-arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.sm: O faoa aai foi ma o latou fanua; sa nonofo nisi o le fanauga a luta i Kiriata-arapa ma ona faoa aai, ma Tipona ma ona faoa aai, ma Kapeseelu ma ona faoa aai,

verses.en: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
verses.sm: ma Iosua, ma Molata, ma Petepaleta,

verses.en: And at Hazar-shual, and at Beer-sheba, and in the villages thereof,
verses.sm: ma Hasarasualo, - ma Peresepa ma ona faoa aai,

verses.en: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.sm: ma Sekeleka, ma Mekoni ma ona faoa aai,

verses.en: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.sm: ma Ainorimoni, ma Sorea, ma laremuta,

verses.en: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer-sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.sm: o Sanoa, o Atulama ma o la faoa aai, o Lakisa ma ona fanua, o Aseka ma ona faoa aai. Ua latou nonofo foi e pau mai Peresepa ua oo atu i le vanu o Hinoma.

verses.en: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth-el, and in their villages,
verses.sm: O le fanauga foi a Peniamina e pau mai i Kipea e pau mai foi i Mekemase, ma Ai, ma Peteli ma o latou faoa aai,

verses.en: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.sm: O Anatota, o Nove, o Anania,

verses.en: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.sm: O Hasora, o Rama, o Kitaima,

verses.en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.sm: o Hatito, o Sepoima, o Nepalatu,

verses.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.sm: o Loto, ma Ono o le vanu o tufuga.

verses.en: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
verses.sm: Sa iai foi i Iuta, ma Peniamina o vasega o sa Levi. O faitaulaga ma sa
